rule: These are route-level economics inputs converted from the banked Caribbean demand-anchor pack. They are not final model rows and all route_id fields stay null until Grok seals exact IDs.
model_gate: No finance/model/corridors.json change until exact route geometry, approved country-reference rows, and demand/fare review are complete.
capture_policy: Tourism and ferry volumes are pre-harvest pools. Draft corridor demand is a conservative launch-capture assumption and must not be summed across overlapping pools without dedupe.

fare.source: Bahamas Air Tours visitor guide reports recent Nassau/Paradise Island water taxi fare at $7 one-way as of 2025, while warning service reliability is uncertain.

demand.pool_basis: 2019 Bahamas baseline: 1,292,424 Nassau/Paradise Island stopovers + 5,429,474 cruise visitors from the existing demand-anchor pack.
demand.dedupe_warning: Cruise visitors and stayovers overlap with other Nassau transfer routes; do not sum without launch cluster dedupe.
